sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A STRONG UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH WITH A 90+ KT MID LEVEL JET MAX WILL MOVE FROM THE FOUR CORNERS AREA NEWD ACROSS THE PLAINS AND INTO THE MID MO/MS VALLEY DURING THE EVENING. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL DEEPEN OVER NEB AND MOVE INTO WRN IA BY 00Z WITH A DRYLINE EXTENDING SWD ALONG THE KS/MO BORDER AND INTO E CNTRL OK/NRN TX. SLY FLOW ACROSS A LARGELY CAPPED WARM SECTOR WILL MAINTAIN BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S F AS FAR N AS IA AND CNTRL IL NEAR A WARM FRONT. FORCING WITH THE LOW AND HEATING ALONG AND W OF THE DRYLINE WILL LIKELY LEAD TO AN ACTIVE SEVERE WEATHER DAY OVER A RELATIVELY FOCUSED AREA.

sections.title: ERN NEB/KS INTO IA/NRN MO/NWRN IL
sections.text: ELEVATED/PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE CONVECTION WITH HAIL WILL BE ONGOING FROM ERN SD INTO SRN MN WHERE STRONG ISENTROPIC LIFT WILL EXIST N OF THE WARM FRONT AND BENEATH STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT. TO THE S...CAPPING WILL INHIBIT CONVECTION UNTIL AROUND 21Z WHEN STRONG HEIGHT FALLS AND DEEP MIXING ERODE INHIBITION OVER ERN NEB. STRONG UVVS AND ADVECTION OF STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL ALLOW FOR MUCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000 J/KG TO DEVELOP FROM ERN NEB INTO IA AND FAR NRN MO BY LATE AFTERNOON. THE GREATEST THREAT FOR TORNADOES...LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE FROM FAR ERN NEB ACROSS MUCH OF IA...PERHAPS EXTENDING INTO FAR NRN MO. THIS AREA...BOUNDED BY THE DRYLINE TO THE W AND WARM FRONT TO THE N...WILL HAVE VERY STRONG SHEAR PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS AND TORNADOES. JUXTAPOSITION OF GREATEST SHEAR AND INSTABILITY IS LIKELY TO BE OVER IA...PERHAPS EXTREME ERN NEB IF THE DRYLINE MOVES MORE SLOWLY. HOWEVER...FAST STORM MOTIONS WILL LIMIT TEMPORAL WINDOW AVAILABLE FOR TORNADOES AS STORMS BECOME ELEVATED AS THEY CROSS THE WARM FRONT. WHILE SYNOPTIC SETUP AND SHEAR WOULD APPEAR TO FAVOR STRONG TORNADOES...BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE QUALITY AND INSTABILITY ARE LIKELY TO BE A LIMITING FACTO

sections.title: ERN NEB/KS INTO IA...MO AND NRN IL THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER NM/CO THIS MORNING WILL EJECT NEWD OVER KS/NEB TODAY AND REACH NRN MO/IA THIS EVENING...AS A LARGER SCALE MIDLEVEL LOW DEVELOPS EWD FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS TO MN/IA BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE IN CENTRAL NEB WILL DEVELOP EWD ALONG A BAROCLINIC ZONE THAT EXTENDS EWD INTO IA...WITHIN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF A 90-130 KT MID-UPPER JET MAX. THIS KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO FOCUSED ASCENT NEAR AND IMMEDIATELY E OF THE SURFACE LOW THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...AND VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS IN THE WARM SECTOR OF THE CYCLONE. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR FOR A MORE WIDESPREAD/SIGNIFICANT SEVERE STORM EPISODE WILL BE THE MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IN THE WARM SECTOR. LARGE SCALE SUBSIDENCE OVER THE GULF BASIN AND PERSISTENT TRAJECTORIES FROM WITHIN THE RIDGE HAVE INHIBITED APPRECIABLE WARM SECTOR MOISTENING OVER THE PAST SEVERAL DAYS...AND ALLOWED BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE QUALITY TO BE REDUCED EACH AFTERNOON VIA MIXING INLAND FROM THE COAST. THUS...DEWPOINTS ARE UNLIKELY TO INCREASE FROM THE MID-UPPER 50S ALREADY PRESENT. DESPITE THE MODEST MOISTURE...AFTERNOON TEMPERATURES WELL INTO THE 70S/LOW 80

sections.title: IA...MO...IL
sections.text: ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS S CNTRL INTO SERN IA AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT AND ALONG/S OF THE WARM FRONT WHERE INSTABILITY IS GREATEST. 00Z SOUNDING FROM TOP SHOWED RELATIVELY STEEP LOW TO MID LEVEL LAPSE RATE PROFILES WHICH ARE SPREADING NE ACROSS NRN MO. THE TORNADO THREAT REMAINS OVER IA AND CONDITIONALLY OVER NRN MO...WHERE SHEAR AND INSTABILITY PARAMETERS REMAIN FAVORABLE. AS STORMS CROSS THE WARM FRONT...ANY TORNADO AND WIND THREAT SHOULD CEASE. ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY ALONG THE COLD FRONT IS TAKING THE FORM OF A SQUALL LINE AND WILL CONTAIN A WIND AND HAIL THREAT. FOR MORE INFORMATION...SEE FORTHCOMING MD #0251. ELEVATED HAIL STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER ERN IA...SRN WI AND CNTRL/NRN IL THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT AS THE TROUGH CONTINUES EWD AND MARGINAL ELEVATED INSTABILITY SPREADS EWD. FARTHER S ALONG THE DRYLINE...OUN SOUNDING SHOWS A NEARLY MIXED OUT SOUNDING AND LITTLE CIN BUT A COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER AND RELATIVELY MARGINAL LOW LEVEL MOISTURE SUGGEST CAPPING WILL INHIBIT ANY NOCTURNAL CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL ALONG THE DRYLINE. ..JEWELL.. 03/23/2011
